✅ **Fixed!** All tests now pass. 

**The bug:** The merge condition on line 54 was `s.start < last.end`, which only merges overlapping spans. It didn't handle spans that are touching (where one ends exactly where another begins).

**The fix:** Changed the condition to `s.start <= last.end` so that spans that touch or overlap get merged together. Now Span(1, 4) and Span(4, 6) correctly merge into Span(1, 6).
